scripts.test: cargo test -p ssi-pq-core && npm run build && find test-node -name '*.test.js' ! -name 'wallet-pdf-generic-real-files.test.js' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 node --test
scripts.test:wasm: npm run build && npm run build:wasm:test && node --test test-wasm/*.test.js
scripts.ci:linux: cargo test --workspace && npm test && npm run test:wasm && npm run vectors:generate:node && npm run vectors:verify:node && npm run vectors:verify:wasm && npm run security:audit
scripts.ci:react-native: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/react-native && npm test --prefix packages/react-native
